ar.title: فتة كفتة لبنانية باللبن والثوم (فتة كفتة مدقوقة)

steps.n1: افرم اللحم مرتين مع النعناع الطازج والملح والفلفل، وشكّله أقراصاً.
steps.n2: اقلِ الأقراص حتى يحمرّ لونها جيداً.
steps.n3: قطّع الخبز قطعاً صغيرة بحجم اللقمة وضعها في طبق تقديم عميق.
steps.n4: اخلط الزبادي مع الثوم والنعناع الناشف، ثم أضف الزيت المتبقي من قلي الأقراص.
steps.n5: صبّ الزبادي فوق الخبز ورصّ الكفتة على الوجه.

en.title: Lebanese Kafta Fatteh with Garlic Yogurt (Fatteet Kafta Madqooqa)
en.intro: Recipe 248, page 112 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Mince the lamb twice with the fresh mint, salt and pepper, and shape into patties.
steps.n2: Fry the patties until nicely browned.
steps.n3: Break the bread into bite-sized pieces and put them in a deep serving bowl.
steps.n4: Mix the yogurt with the garlic and dried mint, then stir in the oil left from frying the patties.
steps.n5: Pour the yogurt over the bread and top with the kafta.

legacySteps: Mince the lamb twice with the fresh mint, salt and pepper, and shape into patties.
Fry the patties until nicely browned.
Break the bread into bite-sized pieces and put them in a deep serving bowl.
Mix the yogurt with the garlic and dried mint, then stir in the oil left from frying the patties.
Pour the yogurt over the bread and top with the kafta.
